title: Grusch named Sarbacher as the key to the program's architecture

tellings.quote: allow you to understand the architecture of the program. Who would it be? And he said it was Sarbacher.

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence official who has testified to Congress about a hidden programme that he says recovers and studies craft not made by humans, was asked which one person would help someone understand how that programme is structured, and he answered: a man named Robert Sarbacher. Ammar Kandil tells this on the show, saying he heard it from Grusch around 2023 or 2024. If true, it would point researchers to Sarbacher as a way into how the secret effort was built.
